name: Create KB article — EVA suit pressure checklist

body.title: EVA Suit Pre-Egress Pressure Verification Checklist
body.body:
## Purpose
Verify suit integrity before each EVA egress.

## Steps
1. Don suit and connect umbilical.
2. Perform suit donning checks per PLSS checklist.
3. Pressurize to 4.3 psi; hold 5 minutes.
4. Verify pressure loss < 0.1 psi — if exceeded, abort and notify CAPCOM.
5. Switch to O2 prebreathe protocol (60 min at 10.2 psi cabin).
6. Final go/no-go from Flight Surgeon before egress.

## References
- EMU Operations Manual, Section 7.4
- PLSS Checklist Card EVA-02

name: Create and archive KB article — superseded power procedure

body.title: Solar Array Manual Retrack Procedure (Rev A — superseded)
body.body:
## Status
This procedure is superseded by Rev B. Retained for reference only.

## Legacy Steps
1. Inhibit auto-track via GNC console.
2. Select MANUAL on SARJ panel.
3. Command retrack at 0.5 deg/s.
4. Monitor current draw; abort if > 8A.
5. Re-enable auto-track after retrack complete.
